reviews.comment: Lab portion of Forensic Ento. She is a good prof who cares for anyone who is interested in Ento. 3 Lab exams + 6 bonus quizzes + several assignments related to the mock death scene investigation assignment + TOC assignments and depositions. Give yourself time to practice the dichotomous key for the exams. If you like forensics, you'll manage.

Dr. Yoho made going to lecture fun. Her teaching style is great and she makes content easy to understand. There is lots of homework and reading in this course, but everything is tied in with lecture so it is very helpful. She will answer all questions and is so nice! Definitely take her!
Great prof and an interesting class! She does take attendance, but all assignments are online and relatively easy to complete.

FIVS 422: Professor Yoho is one of my favorite professors. She is so kind and caring towards her students and has great knowledge in both Ento and FIVS studies. The only thing I did not like about this course was that the assignments took a little long to be graded. Other than that, 10/10 recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Yoho is an AMAZING professor and person. She has much knowledge in Ento and FIVS. 10/10 recommend. The only thing I did not like about this class is that it took a long time for assignments to get graded, but she grades pretty fairly. Very easy professor and super helpful.

FIVS 420: Dr. Yoho is far and away one of, if not my favorite professors at A&M. She cares so much about her students and is always open to help. She is "human" and will talk to you like you are too, not STRICTLY business. The class was heavy on discussions and had one group project,nothing egregious. Also took for CSI and she was fantastic. 11/10!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Completely asynchronous so make sure to stay on top of work, but it's all super easy and straightforward. Good amount of work but everything is open note open web. There's a final case analysis at the end that takes a lot of time and effort but I'm an English major and got an A no problem just by putting the work in, and I'm not good with sciences.
This class was super easy. It was self paced and feedback was really quick as well. Definitely just do the work and you will be good.

reviews.comment: FIVS 205: Completely online class at self pace. Recommend!! Graded on test, quizzes, and module quizzes. Kind of a lot of work but do it throughout the semester and you're fine.
